contentEn:
Kitchen renovation costs in North Vancouver and surrounding Metro Vancouver cities range from $18,000 to $85,000+ in 2026, depending entirely on scope. A minor cosmetic refresh — new paint, updated lighting, refacing cabinet fronts — runs $18,000–$30,000. A mid-range renovation with new cabinet boxes, quartz countertops and a new sink and faucet runs $30,000–$50,000. A major layout change with custom solid-wood cabinetry, natural stone surfaces, built-in appliances and structural work runs $50,000–$85,000+. Reno Stars has completed kitchen projects across Coquitlam, Burnaby, Richmond, and Langley in 2025 and 2026. Here are the real numbers.

Planning a kitchen renovation in North Vancouver, Coquitlam, Burnaby or the surrounding area? Get a free, no-obligation quote from Reno Stars. All projects are performed by licensed trades, fully insured, and backed by Reno Stars' project warranty.

What Does a Kitchen Renovation Cost in North Vancouver in 2026?

Kitchen renovation pricing in North Vancouver and Metro Vancouver reflects the scope of work, the quality of materials selected, and the complexity of the layout. Here is the current pricing landscape based on Reno Stars' 2025–2026 project data:

  • Minor cosmetic update ($18,000–$30,000): Cabinet door refacing, new hardware, updated light fixtures, fresh paint, new faucet. Layout unchanged. Typical timeline: 3–5 weeks.
  • Mid-range renovation ($30,000–$50,000): New cabinet boxes with new door and drawer fronts, quartz or granite countertops, new sink and faucet, updated electrical (LED recess lighting), new flooring. Layout may shift slightly. Typical timeline: 6–9 weeks.
  • Major custom renovation ($50,000–$85,000+): Custom solid-wood or high-end laminate cabinetry, natural stone countertops (quartzite, granite, marble), built-in appliances, layout changes involving plumbing or electrical rerouting, structural modifications. Typical timeline: 10–16 weeks.

Real Kitchen Renovation Project in Coquitlam — Quartz Island Kitchen

Reno Stars recently completed a kitchen renovation in Coquitlam featuring a waterfall quartz island, custom shaker-style cabinetry, and a full appliance package. The project scope included demo of the existing U-shaped kitchen, relocation of the sink to the island, new waterproof LVP flooring throughout the kitchen and adjacent living space, and installation of a Bosch induction cooktop with integrated downdraft ventilation.

See the completed Coquitlam kitchen renovation project: Coquitlam Kitchen Renovation with Waterfall Quartz Island.

Kitchen Renovation Cost Factors in North Vancouver and Metro Vancouver

Three primary factors determine where your kitchen renovation falls in the $18,000–$85,000 range:

  • Cabinetry: Stock flat-panel cabinets from a home centre start around $150–$250 per linear foot. Custom or semi-custom shaker or slab cabinets from a cabinet shop run $350–$700+ per linear foot. A typical 150–200 sq ft kitchen has 40–50 linear feet of cabinets.
  • Countertops: Laminate: $800–$2,000 total. Quartz: $3,000–$8,000 total. Granite or quartzite: $5,000–$12,000+ total. Marble: $6,000–$15,000+ total.
  • Appliances: Builder-grade appliance packages: $3,000–$5,000. Mid-range (Bosch, GE Café, KitchenAid): $6,000–$12,000. High-end integrated (Miele, Sub-Zero/Wolf, Gaggenau): $15,000–$40,000+.

Do You Need a Permit for a Kitchen Renovation in North Vancouver?

Minor cosmetic updates — painting, cabinet refacing, replacing fixtures without changing plumbing or electrical — do not require a building permit in the City of North Vancouver or most Metro Vancouver municipalities. Permit requirements kick in when the scope involves:

  • Moving or adding plumbing (relocating the sink is the most common example)
  • Altering electrical circuits or adding new ones
  • Removing or modifying load-bearing walls
  • Adding or extending windows or exterior doors

Permit costs for kitchen renovations in North Vancouver typically run $500–$2,500 depending on the scope, plus engineering review if structural work is involved. The City of North Vancouver uses the BC Building Code with local amendments. Reno Stars manages every permit application on behalf of homeowners, including coordination with a structural engineer when required. Typical permit processing time in North Vancouver is 2–4 weeks.

What Is the Timeline for a North Vancouver Kitchen Renovation?

Timeline depends on scope. Here are the realistic ranges based on 2025–2026 Reno Stars project data:

  • Minor cosmetic update: 3–5 weeks from demolition to final clean
  • Mid-range renovation: 6–9 weeks from demo to handover
  • Major custom renovation: 10–16 weeks from initial demo to final walkthrough

The longest phase is typically waiting for custom cabinetry and countertop templating — cabinet lead times in Metro Vancouver currently run 6–10 weeks for custom orders. Quartz and granite fabrication adds another 1–2 weeks after template approval.

  • Waterfall Island Kitchen in Langley

Frequently Asked Questions About Kitchen Renovation in North Vancouver

What does a kitchen renovation cost in North Vancouver in 2026?

A minor cosmetic kitchen update in North Vancouver runs $18,000–$30,000. A mid-range renovation with new cabinetry and quartz countertops runs $30,000–$50,000. A major custom renovation with layout changes, solid-wood cabinets and natural stone surfaces runs $50,000–$85,000+. These are 2026 figures based on Reno Stars' recent Metro Vancouver projects.

How long does a North Vancouver kitchen renovation take?

A minor cosmetic update takes 3–5 weeks. A mid-range renovation takes 6–9 weeks. A major custom renovation takes 10–16 weeks. The longest single phase is custom cabinet fabrication, which currently runs 6–10 weeks in Metro Vancouver. Reno Stars manages the full timeline from permit application through final handover.

Do I need a permit for a kitchen renovation in North Vancouver?

Minor cosmetic work — painting, cabinet refacing, replacing fixtures without changing plumbing or electrical — does not require a permit in the City of North Vancouver. Moving or adding plumbing, altering electrical circuits, or removing load-bearing walls all require permits. Reno Stars handles the permit application process on behalf of homeowners, including any required structural engineering.

Should I replace my kitchen cabinets or reface them?

Refacing works when the existing cabinet boxes are structurally sound, the layout is already functional, and you want to change the appearance. Refacing costs $8,000–$20,000 for a typical kitchen and takes 1–2 weeks. Full replacement costs $25,000–$55,000+ for the cabinet package alone and takes 6–10 weeks for custom orders. Reno Stars provides an on-site assessment to determine whether refacing or replacement delivers better value for your specific situation.

What countertop material offers the best value for a North Vancouver kitchen?

Quartz delivers the best overall value for most North Vancouver kitchens: it is non-porous, requires no sealing, resists staining and chipping, and is available in a wide range of colours and finishes that mimic natural stone. Cost for a typical 150–200 sq ft kitchen is $3,000–$8,000 including template, fabrication and installation. Granite and quartzite offer a natural stone appearance at $5,000–$12,000 but require periodic sealing. Laminate remains the most affordable option at $800–$2,000 but has a shorter lifespan.

北温哥华及大温地区厨房装修费用在2026年为$18,000至$85,000+不等，具体取决于工程范围。轻微美容更新（仅更换门面、灯具和油漆）$18,000–$30,000；含新橱柜、石材台面和改管的中等规模装修$45,000–$85,000+。Reno Stars于2025–2026年在高贵林、本拿比、列治文和兰里完成了多个厨房工程。以下是真实数据。

计划在北温哥华、高贵林、本拿比或其周边地区进行厨房装修？获取Reno Stars的免费、无压力报价。所有项目均由持牌装修师傅完成，完全投保并提供Reno Stars项目保修。

2026年北温哥华厨房装修费用是多少？

北温哥华及大温地区厨房装修价格取决于工程范围、材料选择和布局复杂度。以下是2025–2026年Reno Stars项目数据的当前定价：

  • 轻微美容更新（$18,000–$30,000）：橱柜门板换色、新硬件、更新灯具、墙面刷新、更换水龙头。布局不变。典型工期：3–5周。
  • 中等装修（$30,000–$50,000）：新橱柜箱体和新门板及抽屉面板、石英石或花岗岩台面、新水槽和水龙头、更新电气（内嵌LED灯）、新地板。布局可能有小幅调整。典型工期：6–9周。
  • 大型定制装修（$50,000–$85,000+）：实木或高端层压板定制橱柜、天然石材台面（石英石、花岗岩、大理石）、嵌入式家电、涉及水管或电气改线的布局调整、结构改造。典型工期：10–16周。

高贵林真实厨房装修工程 — 石英石瀑布岛台厨房

Reno Stars近期在高贵林完成了一个厨房装修项目，采用瀑布式石英石岛台、定制纯框风格橱柜和全套家电。项目范围包括拆除现有U形厨房、将水槽移至岛台、全屋新防水LVP地板，以及安装博世电磁灶和集成下排风抽油烟机。

查看已完成的高贵林厨房装修项目：高贵林瀑布石英石岛台厨房装修。

北温哥华和大温地区厨房装修费用的决定因素

三个主要因素决定厨房装修落在$18,000–$85,000的哪个区间：

  • 橱柜：家居中心的成品平板橱柜约$150–$250/延尺。橱柜店定制或半定制纯框/板式橱柜$350–$700+/延尺。典型150–200平方英尺厨房有40–50延尺橱柜。
  • 台面：层压板：总计$800–$2,000。石英石：总计$3,000–$8,000。花岗岩或石英岩：总计$5,000–$12,000+。大理石：总计$6,000–$15,000+。
  • 家电：建筑标准家电套餐：$3,000–$5,000。中端（Bosch、GE Café、KitchenAid）：$6,000–$12,000。高端嵌入式（Miele、Sub-Zero/Wolf、Gaggenau）：$15,000–$40,000+。

北温哥华厨房装修需要许可吗？

轻微美容更新——油漆、橱柜门面更换、更换固定装置而不改变水管或电气——在北温哥华市和大温大多数市镇不需要建筑许可。以下范围需要许可：

  • 移动或添加水管（最常见的是移水槽）
  • 改变电路或添加新电路
  • 拆除或改动承重墙
  • 添加或扩建窗户或外门

北温哥华厨房装修许可费用视范围而定，通常为$500–$2,500，如有结构工程另加工程审核费。Reno Stars代表业主处理每份许可申请，包括在需要时与结构工程师协调。

北温哥华厨房装修的时间线是多少？

时间线取决于工程范围。以下是基于2025–2026年Reno Stars项目数据的实际区间：

  • 轻微美容更新：3–5周（从拆除到最终清洁）
  • 中等装修：6–9周（从拆除到移交）
  • 大型定制装修：10–16周（从初步拆除到最终验收）

最长的阶段通常是等待定制橱柜和台面测量——大温地区定制橱柜目前交货期6–10周。石英石和花岗岩制作在确认图纸后还需额外1–2周。

北温哥华厨房装修常见问题

2026年北温哥华厨房装修费用是多少？

北温哥华轻微美容厨房更新费用为$18,000–$30,000。含新橱柜和石英石台面的中等装修$30,000–$50,000。含布局调整、实木橱柜和天然石材台面的大型定制装修$50,000–$85,000+。这些是2026年数据，基于Reno Stars近期大温地区工程项目。

北温哥华厨房装修需要多长时间？

轻微美容更新3–5周。中等装修6–9周。大型定制装修10–16周。最长的单一阶段是定制橱柜制作，大温地区目前交货期6–10周。Reno Stars从许可申请到最终移交全程管理时间线。

北温哥华厨房装修需要许可吗？

轻微美容工程——油漆、橱柜门面更换、在不改变水管或电气的情况下更换固定装置——在北温哥华市不需要许可。移动或添加水管、改变电路或拆除承重墙均需许可。Reno Stars代表业主处理许可申请流程，包括在需要时配合结构工程师。

应该更换橱柜还是只换门面？

当现有橱柜箱体结构完好、布局已经实用且您想改变外观时，换门面是合理选择。门面更换费用为典型厨房$8,000–$20,000，耗时1–2周。全套更换仅橱柜 package $25,000–$55,000+，定制订单6–10周。Reno Stars提供现场评估，判断换门面还是全换对您的具体情况更划算。

北温哥华厨房台面选什么材料性价比最高？

石英石对大多数北温哥华厨房性价比最高：它无孔、不需密封、抗污抗裂，颜色和质感选择丰富，可模仿天然石材外观。典型150–200平方英尺厨房含测量、制作和安装总计$3,000–$8,000。花岗岩和石英岩外观接近天然石材，费用$5,000–$12,000但需定期密封。层压板最便宜，费用$800–$2,000但使用寿命较短。
